text: 中共中央政治局委员、国务院副总理何立峰10月13日下午在人民大会堂会见法国总统外事顾问博纳，就中法经贸务实合作和中欧经贸关系交换意见。
text_en: Member of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Vice Premier of the State Council He Lifeng met with French President's Diplomatic Advisor Bonne at the Great Hall of the People on the afternoon of October 13, and exchanged views on China-France practical economic and trade cooperation and China-EU economic and trade relations.
